title: How Long Is It?
story: You're creating a password for your new game account. The sign-up form says "Password must be at least 8 characters." You type your secret word, but is it long enough? Your program can check for you in an instant!
why: Counting characters is essential for validating passwords, checking usernames, and making sure text fits in limits.
analogy: string.str_len() is like a ruler for text — it measures exactly how many letters, spaces, and symbols your string contains.
try_it: Measure the length of your full name (first and last with a space between). Then check if it's longer than 10 characters using `>=`. Print both the length and the true/false result!
tips: string.str_len() returns an Int, so you can compare the result with `<`, `>`, `==`, etc.
Count your string characters manually on paper first, then check if the program agrees!
Use str_len to validate input — like making sure a username is between 3 and 20 characters
common_mistakes: Forgetting that spaces count as characters — "my name" has 7 characters, not 6!
Writing `str_len` without `string.` in front — the full name is `string.str_len()`
